fieldValues.description: RFC-039 carrier: object keyed by Field.name ([R2b]).

relations.description: BEHAVIOUR CHANGE (#1134): formerly outbound only. Consumers that assumed `sourceId == recordId` must check `direction`. Both directions; each entry is a RelationSummary plus `direction` (out|in), the other endpoint inline as `neighbour`, and the relation's own optional `createdAt` / `createdBy` (#1246). With `--projection card|label` (#1285) each `neighbour` is a `{kind: "card", instanceId, uri, label, typeNamespace?, typeName?, lifecycleState?, summary?}` card (no `summary` for `label`) and the edge drops its endpoint labels and provenance.
